prompt:
Educational flat-design concept map — mind map illustration, square 1:1 format. Italian middle school textbook (scuola secondaria I grado), DigComp I level. Central hub: large rounded rectangle "💻 Il sistema operativo: come il computer gestisce le risorse", solid fill #006064, white bold sans-serif label, subtle drop shadow. Five branch clusters radiate from the hub with smooth curved lines. Each branch has a colored pill label and 2–5 smaller rounded child nodes:
  • INNESCA [#5E35B1]: "Il task manager / activity monitor" | "Chi comanda davvero nel tuo computer?" | "Hai mai aperto il task manager e…?"
  • ESPLORA [#1565C0]: "Lo studente descrive le funzioni principali…" | "gestione dei processi" | "della memoria" | "del file system e delle periferiche"
  • SPERIMENTA [#E65100]: "sistema operativo / operating system" | "processo / process"
  • AGISCI [#00695C]: "Apri il task manager (o Activity Monitor su…" | "identifica i 5 processi che consumano più RAM…" | "Professione futura: DevOps Engineer"
  • RIPASSA [#F57F17]: "sistema operativo" | "processo" | "memoria RAM" | "file system"
Style rules: white background, all labels in Italian, branch nodes solid fill (branch color) with white text, hub accent stripe #006064 on bottom edge only, connecting lines 2px curved matching branch color, no photographs, no decorative frames, no gradients, clean radial balanced layout, Inter/Nunito-style sans-serif typography, WCAG AA contrast, flat vector illustration, 1:1 square.
